question: the sign ordering behind the published headline was measured at ONE (rebal, n_hold) cell that was itself chosen on the sample -- does the ordering survive the cells it was chosen among?
caveats: All arms are in-sample by construction: this compares three in-sample optima, it does not estimate a live return (E219 caveat applies unchanged).

The three cells are not the full 9-cell walk-forward grid -- they are three declared corners of the same space, chosen before the run and echoed into the payload, so 'stable' means stable across THESE cells, not across all cells.
ETF pool is today's listed set (survivorship), unchanged caveat.
Engine is the reference one (no impact cost, no gap risk); only the cell changes.

checks.check: declared cells equal the module's frozen cells
production rank recomputed from each cell's arm table
per-cell active flag recomputed from the arm census
stable-factor count recomputed from the per-cell effects
